big_case.notes: Federal access for independent section 1983 injuries and procedural safeguards in parental-rights arbitration could matter nationally. Five petition-stage amicus filings show interest beyond the litigant. The actual vehicle was an unpublished, individualized jurisdictional affirmance with alternative immunity barriers, and the routine denial established no new rule.
